text:
lucas.partnerships: quick sync: partner A wants marketplace listing + certified connector badge. target: next-week marketplace refresh. who needs what to certify?
nina.secops: need SAML metadata, SCIM full schema, and HSM attestation report. also want a short data-flow diagram showing where PII/credentials transit.
theo.platform: from runtime side we need compatibility test results for our staging infra (us-east-1 dedicated) and performance numbers (p99 latency for secret fetch). Can partner run our perf harness?
rachel.marketplace: listing copy must include data residency options. Also need pricing SKU (metering) and marketplace logo at 600x200. embargo window?
dan.sre: staging checklist: automated SAML login, SCIM bulk sync, key rotation script test, and HA failover for KMS endpoint. Can someone add synthetic monitor?
vishal.si: SI team will run connector integration at partner test tenant tomorrow. we'll push sample SCIM mapping and a test service-account for KMS. note: partner uses vendor-HSM with cert chain.
margot.legal: confirm we get partner's DPA + SOC2 attestation. for marketplace text avoid claims about FIPS unless partner provides cert. Also restrict publishing HSM attestation details.
lucas.partnerships: good points. let's capture action items: (1) partner provides SAML metadata + cert chain, (2) SCIM schema + example CSV, (3) HSM attestation token + thumbprint, (4) marketplace assets + pricing, (5) performance report.
build-bot: ci: connector-integration/branch/marketplace-checks #512 started, tests: unit ok, integration queued.
nina.secops: sample minimal KMS policy we recommend (paste in runbook):
```
principal: service:connector@redwood
allow: [encrypt,decrypt,get]
resource: projects/*/kms/**
```

vishal.si: posting SCIM sample mapping we used in PoC: {"id":"externalId","userName":"email","name.givenName":"first","name.familyName":"last","emails":["email"]}
theo.platform: perf target: secret fetch <40ms p95, SCIM sync 10k users <8m. we'll provide harness config.
dan.sre: i'll add a synthetic to PagerDuty and a smoke screen for canary region. who owns canary rollout?
lucas.partnerships: ops (dan) to own canary; platform (theo) sets traffic split; marketing (rachel) hold announcement until legal+margot ok.
margot.legal: we need to review marketplace contract addendum. i'll aim to finish review by Fri COB. no public assets until then.
rachel.marketplace: acknowledged, holding embargo. proposed publish date Tue week after cert.
lucas.partnerships: thanks. i'll update the tracker with milestones. ping me once the partner uploads certs and SCIM CSV. :white_check_mark:
